statements.text: The slope of the straight line passing through two points $(x_1, y_1)$, $(x_2, y_2)$ equals $\frac{y_2-y_1}{x_2-x_1}$.
An angle is positive when it is formed by a counter anticlockwise rotation and it is negative when it is formed by a clockwise rotation.
The slope of a straight line is the tangent of the positive angle which the straight line makes with the positive direction of the x axis.
Slope of a straight line = tan E, where E is the positive angle that the straight line makes with the positive direction of the x axis. Formula: $m = \tan E$

context.text: Imagine a map of a hill road drawn on a grid in metres. The road starts at the point $(2, 1)$ and ends at the point $(10, 5)$. We want to know how steep it is. Work out the slope of the road, and then the angle it makes with the positive direction of the x-axis.

statements.text: If L1 is parallel to L2 then m1 = m2. Formula: $L_1 \parallel L_2 \Rightarrow m_1 = m_2$
If two lines are parallel, then their slopes are equal and vice versa.
If m1 = m2 then L1 is parallel to L2. Formula: $m_1 = m_2 \Rightarrow L_1 \parallel L_2$
If two lines have equal slopes, then the two lines are parallel.

context.text: Suppose a town map on a grid shows two straight roads. Road A passes through $(1, 2)$ and $(5, 10)$, and road B passes through $(0, -1)$ and $(3, 5)$. A student says the two roads will never meet. Use their slopes to decide if she is right.

statements.text: For two perpendicular lines, Tan E1 × Tan J2 = -1, i.e. the product of their slopes is -1: m1 × m2 = -1. Formula: $m_1\times m_2=-1$
L1 and L2 are two straight lines with slopes m1, m2, where m1, m2 belong to R*. Formula: $m_1, m_2 \in \mathbb{R}^*$
If L1 is perpendicular to L2, then the product of their slopes is -1. Formula: $L_1 \perp L_2 \Rightarrow m_1 \times m_2 = -1$
The product of the slopes of two perpendicular straight lines is -1, and vice versa: if m1 × m2 = -1 then L1 ⊥ L2. Formula: $m_1 \times m_2 = -1 \Rightarrow L_1 \perp L_2$
If the product of the slopes of two straight lines is -1, then the two lines are perpendicular.
